results.title: UPDATE 4-Target to hire up to 100,000 holiday workers, offer deals earlier
results.content:
Sept 22 (Reuters) - Target Corp said on Thursday it plans to hire up to 100,000 seasonal workers for the holiday season and start offering festive deals earlier than previous years as it gears up for the critical shopping period amid a slowing economy.

The big-box retailer had hired 100,000 workers for last year's holiday season, which was marked by tight labor supply. It had hired about 130,000 seasonal workers in 2019 and in 2020. [...] Oops, something went wrong
